map.玩家连胜 5 把 → 连胜记录 +5；AI 若用「跟打玩家上把」策略，玩家需故意: Player wins 5 in a row → streak +5; if the AI uses a 'mimic your last move' strategy, you must vary on purpose to break its read. Rock/scissors/paper cycle beats each other with no absolute best move.
